_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil regime with unchanged 30d price/momentum near 50 and flat funding; no confirmed breaker to leave the Hope band.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Hope; narrative silent on phase and only describes flow rotation, so no hard conflict but no joint directional call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains range-bound, 30d momentum stays near 50, funding subdued, and phase score holds 63-70
next_move.invalidated_if: momentum and funding expand into 2019 mini-top profile (lift to Optimism) or volatility-led breakdown drops score into Disbelief
